'''Necra Phaest''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She made her living as a utility decorations [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] on board [[Vaiken Spacedock]], where she had a [[Fabricator Droid]] workshop at the Stronghold quarter.<ref name="Vaiken" />

==Behind the scenes==
Necra Phaest first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', a expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released in [[2014]] by [[BioWare]]. Universal prefab MK1-MK3s are traded in with Necra for utility furniture.
